verdict.line: You lose if Malphite banks Q poke and dives in with R once he's 6; you win every extended trade and the late game.

brief.thesis: Malphite's Passive (Granite Shield) absorbs your first auto in every trade, so short poke exchanges favor him, but Dr. Mundo's Passive (Adrenaline Rush) and W (Burning Agony) make this lane about who can sustain a long fight — and you always can. The 54.4% win rate over 643 games confirms this is close but tilted your way once you refuse to short-trade.

theirWindow.when: Shield is up and Q (Seismic Shard) off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He'll poke you with Q then auto behind the shield for free value. Don't trade back into a fresh shield — walk up only after he's used an auto or taken damage recently to strip it.

yourWindow.when: Shield is down, you're sub-50% HP
yourWindow.what: Pop E (Masochism) for the missing-health AD bonus and chain Q (Infected Cleaver) into extended auto trades. Burning Agony's drain-damage adds up over a long fight he can't match without his shield.

powerCurve.note: Q poke plus shield wins short trades
Sustain and Masochism start closing the gap
Heartsteel stacks, Adrenaline Rush outsustains him

start.why: The passive block and sustain blunt his auto-heavy Q-into-auto poke pattern while his Granite Shield is up.

boots.why: Taken in 62.9% of games at 58.3% win rate — the extra move speed lets you dodge his E (Ground Slam) shockwave and close distance once he's out of Q range.

core.why: Stacks fastest when you're trading often, and the bonus health directly fuels Adrenaline Rush sustain.
Taken alongside Heartsteel in the top two build paths (64% and 57.7% win rate) — turns every long trade into one you win on raw HP.
Boosts your healing from Adrenaline Rush and Burning Agony specifically against his magic damage kit.

situational.when: the game is dragging and you want more wave clear and poke damage
he's building into auto-attack reliant brawling with Brutal Strikes
he's stacking armor and you need the grievous wounds to cut his sustain

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs on every extended trade and scales your max health, directly answering his short-trade poke pattern with long-fight sustain.

summoners.why: Ghost is run in 53.1% of games — it closes the gap on his Q-slow poke and helps you stick on him once his Granite Shield is down, while Teleport keeps you relevant for his level 6 R gank setups elsewhere on the map.

playing.title: Never trade into a fresh shield
playing.detail: Granite Shield blocks your first hit when it's charged. Wait for him to auto or take poke damage before you commit autos.

playing.title: Save E for the long trade
playing.detail: Masochism's AD scales off missing health — don't pop it early, use it once you're already deep in a sustained fight so the bonus AD lands on more swings.

playing.title: Respect R at level 6
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force can charge in from 1000 range to knock you up and set a gank. Ward your flanks and don't overextend past minion wave once he hits 6.

playing.title: Use Q to contest farm, not to all-in
playing.detail: Infected Cleaver's max-health damage is great for poke and farm pressure, but it's on a 4s cooldown — spam it to contest CS rather than committing to all-ins off a single cast.

playing.title: Burning Agony wins extended skirmishes
playing.detail: The continual drain damage from W adds up over 3+ seconds of close-range fighting, which is exactly the fight length Malphite struggles to win against your sustain.

playing.title: Use Sadism to disengage or re-engage sustain fights
playing.detail: R's health regen and move speed buff let you either chase down a losing Malphite or reset mid-fight — use it once you're both committed to a long trade.

playing.title: Itemize through Spirit Visage against his magic damage
playing.detail: All of his damage (Q, W bonus AD aside, E) is magic — Spirit Visage's healing amp compounds with both your Passive and W to out-sustain him late.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the trade-pattern and timing analysis is my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Both champions have a hard time killing each other. Use [Q] to contest and farm lane. After reaching level 6, be careful of (R) setting up a gank!
